verdict.rationale: Framer documents that every change made by an external AI agent automatically lands on a branch. Users can undo those changes, review the branch and choose when to merge it. Separately, all site changes are auto-saved to a version history that can be restored in seconds. This covers versioning, review and rollback of what automations produce, but not of the automation definitions themselves. Missing for 10: versioning, review and rollback of automation definitions (Server API scripts, plugins, agent instructions); rollback specifically for CMS writes made via the API; independent or hands-on corroboration.
